title: tiquilia mexicana
intro: Tiquilia mexicana, commonly known as the Mexican purslane or San Andrés, is a plant species belonging to the family Boraginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Tiquilia mexicana include its ability to reduce pain, lower blood pressure, and act as an antimicrobial agent. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
